snippets.snippet_text: "In February etsy.com received 326.37M visits with the average session duration 09:26. Compared to January traffic to etsy.com has decreased by -17.38%."
"On etsy.com, visitors mainly come from Direct (49.52% of traffic), followed by google.com (20.25%). In most cases, after visiting etsy.com, users go to google.com and etsystatic.com."
